blocks.text: Is chapter mein students Python mein Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) ki bunyadi baatein seekhenge. Woh OOP ke aham concepts, jaise classes aur objects, dekhenge jin se asal duniya ki cheezon (real-world entities) ka code mein model banaya jata hai. Chapter mein encapsulation hai, jo data ko mehfooz aur private rakhti hai, aur inheritance, jis se code dobara istemal (reuse) aur barhaya (extend) ja sakta hai. Students polymorphism bhi parhenge jis se lachakdar (flexible) programs bante hain. Yeh concepts achhi tarah munazzam (well-structured) aur aasani se sambhalne wali (maintainable) Python applications banane mein madad dete hain. Chapter ke aakhir tak students OOP ke usool (principles) istemal kar ke achhe aur barhne ke qabil (scalable) programs design kar sakenge.

Object-Oriented Programming programs design karne ka aik tareeqa hai jis mein objects aur classes istemal hote hain. Har object asal duniya ki kisi cheez ko dikhata hai jis ki apni properties (khusoosiyat) aur behaviours (kaam) hote hain. Classes templates (saanche) ki tarah hain jin se milti julti khusoosiyat wale bohat se objects banaye jate hain. OOP data aur behaviour ko achhi tarah sambhalne ke liye encapsulation, inheritance aur polymorphism par zor deti hai. Is tareeqe se asal duniya ke masail ka programming mein model banana asaan ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Procedural programming aur OOP ka muqabla (comparison) karta hua chart banayein. Students batayein ke kin suraton mein OOP zyada mufeed hai.

blocks.caption: Procedural programming aur OOP (class activity ke liye)
rows: Alag data par kaam karte functions (qadam)
Objects jo data aur methods ikatthe rakhte
Classes dobara use; inheritance se wasee
Data aam taur par har function ke liye khula
Encapsulation data ko methods ke peeche chhupati
Bare programs jo bohat si haqeeqi cheezon ka model banayein, jaise school ya bank system

blocks.text: OOP ke fawaid: Modularity, Reusability aur aasan dekh-bhaal (maintenance)

OOP code ko modules (hisson) mein baant deti hai, is liye code sambhalna aasan hota hai. Classes aur objects kai programs ya program ke kai hisson mein dobara istemal ho sakte hain, is se aik hi code baar baar likhna nahi parta. OOP se bane programs ko sambhalna aur update karna aasan hai, kyunke aik hisse ki tabdeeli poore system par asar nahi dalti. OOP ki banawat software ko barhne (scalability) aur halaat ke mutabiq dhalne (adaptability) mein madad deti hai. Yeh code ko samajhne ke qabil aur munazzam bana kar team ke saath mil kar kaam (collaboration) bhi behtar karti hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming programmers ko asal zindagi ki cheezon, jaise students ya gariyon, ki soorat mein sochne deti hai, is liye programs samajhna aur sambhalna aasan ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Object-Oriented Programming kya hai, aur is ke do fawaid kya hain?
blocks.explanation: OOP classes aur objects se programs design karti hai jo haqeeqi cheezon ka model hain. Fawaid mein modularity (code qabil-e-intizam classes mein) aur reusability (code dobara likhne ke bajaye classes dobara use) shamil hain; dekh-bhaal bhi asan hoti hai.

items: OOP: classes (saanche) aur objects (asal cheezein) se programs banana.
Fawaid: modularity, reusability, aasan maintenance, scalability aur behtar team work.
